title: Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter)
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this instrumentation application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by flow metering orifice plate and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining from plate for instrumentation geometry
TIG welding all-position with 0.5mm corner radius
Passivation DI rinse with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for flow metering orifice application
commonFailures: Biofouling accumulation on stagnant surfaces - reduced by smooth surface finish Ra <0.8um and regular CIP — critical for flow metering orifice performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) suitable for Flow metering orifice plate?
faq.a: Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address instrumentation operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for flow metering orifice requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. flow metering orifice components require Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for flow metering orifice application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Orifice Plate (Flow Meter) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet flow metering orifice specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Orifice plate / Flow meter plate instrumentation components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
